lines.zh: 两颗脑袋，四条腿，走得整齐。
lines.en: Two heads, four legs, and one steady gait.

lines.zh: 左边看路，右边看你。
lines.en: The left one watches the road, the right one you.

lines.zh: 我们走路会吵架，方向一致。
lines.en: We argue while walking, yet head the same way.

lines.zh: 脚步比单头的沉一倍。
lines.en: Our steps land twice as heavy as a one-headed kin.

lines.zh: 一个想快，一个想慢，折中。
lines.en: One wants speed, one wants slowness; we compromise.

lines.zh: 两双眼睛，总有一双盯着你。
lines.en: Two pairs of eyes, and one pair is always on you.

lines.zh: 脖子各转各的，身体只往前走。
lines.en: Necks turn separately; the body only goes forward.

lines.zh: 我们走起来，草被踩出两道。
lines.en: Walking, we press two trails into the grass.

lines.zh: 别站在我们中间，会挤。
lines.en: Do not stand between us; it gets crowded.

lines.zh: 走到哪都有人问哪个头说话。
lines.en: Everywhere we go, someone asks which head talks.

lines.zh: 我们轮流休息，另一个守夜。
lines.en: We take turns resting; the other keeps watch.

lines.zh: 三十颗心，一半分给每个头。
lines.en: Thirty hearts, half for each head.

lines.zh: 一个头打盹，一个头数你。
lines.en: One head dozes; the other keeps count of you.

lines.zh: 安静时我们商量事情。
lines.en: When it is quiet, we discuss things.

lines.zh: 商量什么？商量先咬哪边。
lines.en: Discussing what? Which side to bite first.

lines.zh: 两颗脑袋都不太会小声说话。
lines.en: Neither head is good at whispering.

lines.zh: 我这边想睡，那边在哼歌。
lines.en: This side wants sleep; that side hums.

lines.zh: 两个头同时叹气，很响。
lines.en: Both heads sigh at once, and it is loud.

lines.zh: 站着不动时，我们互相看着。
lines.en: Standing still, we look at each other.

lines.zh: 你别动，我们正讨论你呢。
lines.en: Hold still; we are discussing you.

lines.zh: 一个说走，一个说等，等着。
lines.en: One says go, one says wait. So we wait.

lines.zh: 火药味从两张嘴里一起出来。
lines.en: The smell of powder leaves both mouths together.

lines.zh: 两个头都在看你，别选错。
lines.en: Both heads are watching you. Choose carefully.

lines.zh: 你只跟一个打招呼？失礼。
lines.en: You greeted only one of us? Rude.

lines.zh: 左边这个先看到你的。
lines.en: The left one spotted you first.

lines.zh: 右边那个记住了你的鞋。
lines.en: The right one memorized your boots.

lines.zh: 我们看人从不一起眨眼。
lines.en: We never blink at the same time.

lines.zh: 你眼睛忙不过来了吧。
lines.en: Your eyes must be struggling to keep up.

lines.zh: 一个盯手，一个盯脚。
lines.en: One watches your hands, one your feet.

lines.zh: 你把头转来转去，我们也转。
lines.en: You turn your head about; so do we.

lines.zh: 四只眼睛，结论是跑不掉。
lines.en: Four eyes, one conclusion: you cannot run.

lines.zh: 看够了就说一声，我们好动手。
lines.en: Say when you are done looking, so we can start.

lines.zh: 一个头疼，另一个也跟着叫。
lines.en: One head hurts; the other yells along.

lines.zh: 你砍的是我，还是他？
lines.en: Did you cut me, or him?

lines.zh: 两张嘴一起骂你，很难听。
lines.en: Both mouths curse you, and it is ugly.

lines.zh: 我们流一样的血，疼两份。
lines.en: We bleed the same blood and hurt twice.

lines.zh: 别打头，我们靠这个吵架。
lines.en: Do not hit the heads; we need them to argue.

lines.zh: 这一下让两个头暂时统一了。
lines.en: That blow briefly united both heads.

lines.zh: 我还站着，两个头都还醒着。
lines.en: Still standing, and both heads are awake.

lines.zh: 你砍偏了，偏到另一个头上。
lines.en: You missed — into the other head.

lines.zh: 疼得我们忘了刚才在吵什么。
lines.en: It hurts so much we forgot the argument.

lines.zh: 再打，我们就不客气地一起上。
lines.en: Hit us again and we both come at you.

lines.zh: 食物？两张嘴意见不统一。
lines.en: Food? The two mouths disagree.

lines.zh: 一个想吃，一个说别碰。
lines.en: One wants to eat; one says leave it.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我们都在看手。
lines.en: You raise the bread; both of us watch your hand.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴不认胡萝卜。
lines.en: This mouth does not recognize carrots.

lines.zh: 喂我们得喂两份，你算过吗。
lines.en: Feeding us means two portions. Have you counted?

lines.zh: 我们不饿，我们只是想吃。
lines.en: We are not hungry. We just want to eat.

lines.zh: 小麦？那东西塞牙。
lines.en: Wheat? That stuff gets stuck in the teeth.

lines.zh: 别用肉引我们，我们更喜欢追。
lines.en: Do not lure us with meat; we prefer the chase.

lines.zh: 两个头抢一块肉，会打架。
lines.en: Two heads fighting over one piece of meat will brawl.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，只值一次分心。
lines.en: What you hold is worth exactly one distraction.

lines.zh: 撞上了，两个头一起回头。
lines.en: We collide, and both heads turn back.

lines.zh: 你挤到我们中间，很勇敢。
lines.en: Squeezing between us was brave.

lines.zh: 一边肩膀撞我，另一边也跑不了。
lines.en: One shoulder hit me; the other side cannot flee either.

lines.zh: 退后点，我们转身慢。
lines.en: Step back; we turn slowly.

lines.zh: 相撞后我们吵了一架，怪你。
lines.en: After the bump we argued, and blamed you.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你的骨头薄。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your bones are thin.

lines.zh: 碰一下，硝粉从两张嘴喷出来。
lines.en: One bump and powder puffs from both mouths.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，两只都踩了。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Both of them.

lines.zh: 挤过来，是想被两头一起咬吗。
lines.en: Crowding in — do you want to be bitten by both?

lines.zh: 我们侧身让你，只让一半。
lines.en: We turn sideways to let you pass. Only halfway.

lines.zh: 要找伴？先分清我们谁是谁。
lines.en: Looking for a mate? First tell us apart.

lines.zh: 两个头，一个身体，没法成双。
lines.en: Two heads, one body — we cannot pair off.

lines.zh: 同族相遇，四个头一起点头。
lines.en: Kin meet and four heads nod together.

lines.zh: 我的另一半就在我脖子上。
lines.en: My other half is right here on my neck.

lines.zh: 想给我们配对？先找两副身体。
lines.en: Pair us up? Find two bodies first.

lines.zh: 我们争过谁先找伴，没结果。
lines.en: We argued over who courts first. No verdict.

lines.zh: 双头是天生一对，别拆散。
lines.en: Two heads are a born pair. Do not split us.

lines.zh: 另一个头说它不需要爱情。
lines.en: The other head says it has no need for love.

lines.zh: 我们共用一颗心，别问这个。
lines.en: We share one heart, so do not ask that.

lines.zh: 配对这事，两个头投了反对票。
lines.en: On mating, both heads voted no.

lines.zh: 我们弯腰捡东西会撞头。
lines.en: Bending to pick things up, our heads collide.

lines.zh: 两个人格，一个想捡，一个不肯。
lines.en: Two minds: one wants to pick it up, one refuses.

lines.zh: 地上的火药，闻着像亲戚。
lines.en: Gunpowder on the ground smells like family.

lines.zh: 没有手，只能用嘴叼。
lines.en: No hands, so we carry things in our mouths.

lines.zh: 叼起来的东西，另一张嘴要抢。
lines.en: Whatever one mouth holds, the other grabs for.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我们踢来踢去。
lines.en: Your dropped sword: we kick it back and forth.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，视野会变窄。
lines.en: While picking things up, our view narrows.

lines.zh: 谁掉的食物？两张嘴都说要。
lines.en: Someone dropped food? Both mouths claim it.

lines.zh: 我们只捡能咬的东西。
lines.en: We only pick up what can be bitten.

lines.zh: 别往地上扔东西，会引起争吵。
lines.en: Do not drop things; it starts an argument.

lines.zh: 两个头同时看见你了。
lines.en: Both heads saw you at the same moment.

lines.zh: 一个说你弱，一个说你快。
lines.en: One says you are weak; one says you are fast.

lines.zh: 结论一致：先追再说。
lines.en: Agreed conclusion: chase first, discuss later.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，两张嘴都闻到了。
lines.en: Both mouths caught your scent.

lines.zh: 我们分工：我看左边，他看右边。
lines.en: We split it: I take left, he takes right.

lines.zh: 目标定了，就是咳嗽那个。
lines.en: Target set: the one who coughed.

lines.zh: 别躲，四条腿比你快。
lines.en: Do not hide; four legs beat yours.

lines.zh: 认出你需要两双眼睛。
lines.en: Recognizing you took two pairs of eyes.

lines.zh: 我们吵完了，决定吃你。
lines.en: We finished arguing and decided to eat you.

lines.zh: 你动一下，两个头都跟着转。
lines.en: One move from you and both heads turn.

lines.zh: 名字不知道，位置很清楚。
lines.en: No name, but the position is clear.

lines.zh: 锁定了，这回两张嘴都闭上。
lines.en: Locked on. This time both mouths shut.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味从那边飘过来。
lines.en: Your iron smell drifts over from there.

lines.zh: 追你这件事，我们从不投票。
lines.en: On chasing you, we never bother to vote.

lines.zh: 两个头都转向你了。
lines.en: Both heads turned to you.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，一起去看看。
lines.en: Noise over there. Let's both go.

lines.zh: 我们放慢脚步，压低头。
lines.en: We slow our steps and lower both heads.

lines.zh: 一个数你的步，一个数距离。
lines.en: One counts your steps, one counts the distance.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角了，我们都知道。
lines.en: You backed into the corner; we both know.

lines.zh: 两张嘴同时在磨牙。
lines.en: Two mouths grind their teeth at once.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会看见两双眼。
lines.en: Do not look back; you will see two pairs of eyes.

lines.zh: 左边想扑，右边说再等等。
lines.en: The left wants to lunge; the right says wait.

lines.zh: 我们离你还有五步，数得准。
lines.en: Five steps out, and we counted accurately.

lines.zh: 你把盾举起来，只挡得住一边。
lines.en: Raise your shield; it covers one side only.

lines.zh: 脚步声太重，藏不住了。
lines.en: Our steps are too heavy to hide now.

lines.zh: 两个头互相点头，意思是上。
lines.en: The heads nod at each other. That means go.

lines.zh: 你听，两张嘴一起喘气。
lines.en: Listen: both mouths breathing together.

lines.zh: 我们绕开石头，不绕开你。
lines.en: We go around stones, never around you.

lines.zh: 这一段路，我们走得比刚才认真。
lines.en: We walk this stretch more seriously than before.

lines.zh: 准备好了，两个头都咬得动。
lines.en: Ready. Both heads can bite through.

lines.zh: 我们压低身子，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: We crouch low and close the gap.

lines.zh: 一个盯着你，一个盯着门。
lines.en: One watches you, one the door.

lines.zh: 你先动手，还是我们先？
lines.en: You strike first, or we do?

lines.zh: 两张嘴都在流口水。
lines.en: Both mouths are drooling.

lines.zh: 我们踩碎了一块石头。
lines.en: We crushed a stone underfoot.

lines.zh: 再近一点，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: One step more and you're caught.

lines.zh: 两张嘴一起咬，你挑哪边挡。
lines.en: Two mouths bite at once. Which side will you block?

lines.zh: 这一口是左边那个的。
lines.en: That bite belonged to the left one.

lines.zh: 右边那个补上了第二口。
lines.en: The right one added the second bite.

lines.zh: 你砍中一个头，另一个还在咬。
lines.en: You cut one head; the other keeps biting.

lines.zh: 我们咬住就不松，牙卡在缝里。
lines.en: Once we bite, we do not let go; teeth lodge in the seam.

lines.zh: 疼？我们两个都疼，都不松口。
lines.en: Pain? We both feel it and neither lets go.

lines.zh: 这一下是我们商量好的。
lines.en: That strike was agreed upon beforehand.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，两张嘴跟上半步。
lines.en: You step back half; two mouths follow half.

lines.zh: 我们轮流咬，谁也累不着。
lines.en: We take turns biting, so neither tires.

lines.zh: 咬合力分两半，还是比你硬。
lines.en: Our bite split in two is still harder than you.

lines.zh: 你听见两张嘴同时合上的声音吗。
lines.en: Did you hear both mouths close at once?

lines.zh: 打我们一个头，另一个会更凶。
lines.en: Hit one head and the other gets meaner.

lines.zh: 这一口留个印，下次好认。
lines.en: This bite leaves a mark, so we know you later.

lines.zh: 打完了，两个头开始争功劳。
lines.en: Done fighting, and both heads claim the credit.

lines.zh: 我这里咬一口，他那里撞一下。
lines.en: I bite here; he rams there.

lines.zh: 两张嘴同时张开，声音很大。
lines.en: Both mouths open wide and loud.

lines.zh: 我们的牙不一样长，咬得都疼。
lines.en: Uneven teeth, equally painful.

lines.zh: 他被你打了，我更生气。
lines.en: You hit him, so now I'm angrier.

lines.zh: 我们一人一边，你顾不过来。
lines.en: One each side; you can't cover both.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在护甲缝上。
lines.en: This bite found the seam in your armor.

lines.zh: 出生时两个头吵了第一架。
lines.en: At birth, the two heads had their first quarrel.

lines.zh: 从蠕变维度的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: We squeezed out of a crack in Creeponia.

lines.zh: 一具身体，两颗脑袋，天生如此。
lines.en: One body, two heads. Born this way.

lines.zh: 谁把我们捏成这样的？站出来。
lines.en: Who shaped us like this? Step forward.

lines.zh: 刚站稳，两个头就开始争方向。
lines.en: Barely standing, both heads argued over direction.

lines.zh: 六十点血，够我们吵很久。
lines.en: Sixty points of health is plenty for long arguments.

lines.zh: 我们的影子有两个后脑勺。
lines.en: Our shadow has two backs of heads.

lines.zh: 别围观，我们不喜欢被数脑袋。
lines.en: Do not gather round; we dislike being counted.

lines.zh: 出生第一天就知道要一起走。
lines.en: On day one we knew we would walk together.

lines.zh: 硝粉落在地上，像下了层灰。
lines.en: Powder settled on the ground like a layer of ash.

lines.zh: 这片地方归我们了，两个头说的。
lines.en: This patch is ours, both heads agree.

lines.zh: 你站远点，我们正在分左右。
lines.en: Stand back; we are sorting out left and right.

lines.zh: 火烧到两张脸，味道一样焦。
lines.en: Fire reached both faces; they burn the same.

lines.zh: 一起摔下来，两个头磕在一起。
lines.en: We fell together and the two heads knocked.

lines.zh: 两张嘴同时进水，谁也没呛赢。
lines.en: Both mouths filled at once; neither choked louder.

lines.zh: 被炸得两个头都耳鸣。
lines.en: The blast left both heads ringing.

lines.zh: 箭插在中间，两个头都够得着。
lines.en: The arrow landed between us, within reach of both.

lines.zh: 这味道两张嘴都吐了出来。
lines.en: Both mouths spat out that taste.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，连吵架都没力气。
lines.en: Hungry, we lack even the strength to argue.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我们中间，两头都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck between us; both heads went numb.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，两张嘴都没声了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, both mouths went silent.
